name: Flows 1
definition: Payments to and from a concentration bank account of a central counterparty.

PaymentBankFlows.name: Payment Bank Flows
PaymentBankFlows.definition: Gross value of flows between the concentration bank account and accounts held at payment banks.

InvestmentFlows.name: Investment Flows
InvestmentFlows.definition: Gross value of flows between the concentration bank account and investment counterparties in respect of maturing investments and any other flows in / out of the concentration account.
